name: collect
prompt: Create ONE production UI icon for a refined paper-and-pencil iPad learning app. Square composition. Real transparent background, no paper square, no white matte, no vignette, no halo, no cast shadow. Only graphite pencil marks should have opacity; empty areas truly transparent. Hand drawn with a soft dark 4B graphite pencil: confident thick imperfect contours, subtle double-traced edges and visible graphite grain inside the strokes, very sparse short hatching. Dark charcoal, monochrome, no colors or shading washes. Looks genuinely drawn by hand, not a geometric vector or SF Symbol, yet immediately legible at 32pt. Keep shape very simple, broad bold strokes, no tiny decorative details. One centered icon filling about 80 percent of the square with equal breathing room on every side. Match the scale and pencil weight of a cohesive five-icon navigation family. No text, lettering, labels, border, surrounding objects or pencil tool. Subject: A shallow open inbox tray holding three loose sheets of paper, with one small confident downward arrow above the sheets. Front view with only slight perspective. The idea is gathering material.
